I am researcher interested in using data science techniques to create data informed policy recommendations. I am interested in using quantitative research methods to study urban policy and planning. I have previously contributed to the Canadian Election Study ([CES](http://www.ces-eec.ca)) and worked extensively as a research assistant for the Laurier Institute for the Study of Public Opinion and Policy ([LISPOP](https://lispop.ca)), Université du Québec à Montréal, and the Centre for the Study of Democratic Citizenship.


I previously revived a Master's Degree in Political Science from [McGill University](https://www.mcgill.ca/politicalscience/) and a Bachelor's degree in Political Science from [Wilfrid Laurier University](https://students.wlu.ca/programs/arts/political-science/index.html).
